question: Why are ordinary beings never capable of knowing the peaceful, dark, peace-giving digit?
premises: There is a peaceful, dark, peace-giving digit.
Knowing it is the issue at stake.
Beings are not capable of knowing it at any time.
inference: The subtle peace-giving digit remains beyond the cognitive capacity of ordinary beings.
uncertainties: The term 'sānta+amasīṃ' may have specific tantric connotations.
plain_english: They are never capable of knowing that peaceful, dark, peace-giving digit.
